correctness.rationale: For all positive parameters, n>=1 and sigma>nu+sigma_i, pointwise inward boundaries prove positivity. Uniform substrate ceiling and scalar product growth bounds establish forward completeness. The exact M=x+y/q identity proves divergence for lambda<=0; uniform saturation and a scalar trapping proof yield x->xi. Exact integrated identity for lambda=0 yields the additive constant, while bounded forcing, eventual exponential comparison and dominated convergence prove positive exponential amplitude and the -q nu/mu offset for lambda<0. For lambda>0, scalar upper bounds give boundedness. Rechecked symbolic identities and finite illustrative integrations by executing the embedded script. Numerical data are not the proof.

value.rationale: The sign of net product clearance is an exact natural structural boundary for the same globally bifurcating allosteric oscillator. The result covers every positive initial state, establishes not just escape but exact physical-time rates and offsets, and supplies a universal substrate saturation limit independent of Hill cooperativity. This determines the mathematical domain in which bounded oscillatory attractors are possible and separates positive, zero and negative removal without relying on numerical continuation. No global bifurcation claim is made in the positive regime.
